title: Understanding Correlation
text: To investigate the correlation between two variables, consider visualizations that show how one variable changes with respect to the other. Think about scatter plots or line graphs.

title: Choosing the Right Visualization
text: Which of the following visualizations would best show the relationship between the amount of antibiotic and the number of colonies?

title: Why Not Histograms?
text: Histograms are useful for showing the distribution of a single variable, not the relationship between two variables. Consider if this is what you need for correlation.
